question_text: Before beginning voice lessons, Kaylee already knew how to sing 5 pieces, and she expects to learn 1 new piece during each week of lessons. How many weeks of lessons will Kaylee need before she will be able to sing a total of 46 pieces?
solution: Extract the key information from the question: Kaylee currently knows 5 songs. She will learn 1 new song per week. We want to find how many more weeks of lessons are needed for Kaylee to know 46 songs in total.
The number of songs Kaylee still needs to learn = The total number of songs Kaylee wants to know - The number of songs Kaylee already knows
The number of songs Kaylee still needs to learn = $46 - 5$ = $41$ songs
Number of weeks Kaylee needs = Number of weeks it takes Kaylee to learn a song $\times$ Number of songs Kaylee still needs to learn
Number of week Kaylee needs = $1 \times 41$ = $41$ weeks
